name: beastmaster
description: mods/beastmaster: a beast from the collection is called, shows on the HUD line, answers the bare /beastmaster command and goes home again. Needs beastmaster switched on (a copy of mods/beastmaster with "enabled": true, installed as emf\mods\beastmaster) and tools/models/model_viewer (god mode), e.g. scripts/game_session.ps1 start -Mods <copy>=beastmaster,tools/models/model_viewer, and a LOCAL world.

steps.expect: /beastmaster list | tame | feed | call | dismiss | attack
